rationale: This is a near-duplicate of two archive entries — it keeps the identical RANK(lt/at) conditioner and merely swaps the profitability change for an own-history position measure, which is exactly what "Levered Profit Trough Recovery" already tested (and which failed, fmb 0.049), so it reads as a cosmetic variant of the successful "Levered Gross Profit Repair" rather than a new mechanism.

The base term is effectively earnings-less-working-capital-accruals (a cash-flow/Sloan-accrual proxy, so partly a known anomaly), and the conditioner (lct−act)/at is the mechanical negative of the wcap used inside the base term, but the level-versus-change separation keeps it interpretable and the interaction with current-liability pressure is a legitimate, higher-coverage repair of the failed oancf route.

Subtracting a bounded margin level from an unbounded growth rate is an arbitrary, unit-incommensurate construction whose variance will be dominated by revenue growth alone, and the economic content is a functional-form respecification of the archive's "Distress-Funded Low-Margin Growth" (which already delivered ls_talpha −3.13), so it is a cosmetic rather than substantive variant.

The SG&A-trend × retained-deficit pairing is a genuinely untested combination and the sign convention is internally consistent (NEG of a declining trend ⇒ positive), though the RANK(NEG(re/at)) conditioner has now failed in three archive signals and the multi-year TREND may just smooth an already-weak overhead-change signal.

SUB(ebitda/at, oiadp/at) reduces almost exactly to depreciation-and-amortization intensity (dp/at), so the "EBITDA overstatement gap" framing is a relabeling of a trivial capital-intensity ratio, and its negative expected sign runs against the accrual anomaly's prediction (high depreciation ⇒ low accruals ⇒ higher returns) without the proposal acknowledging or resolving the conflict.

Adding the unprofitability rank makes this economically distinct from the archive's "Cash-Poor Discretionary Spend Strain" and the distress-financing story is coherent with the negative sign, but the triple rank interaction plus COALESCE(xrd,0) pooling of non-reporters with true zero-R&D firms risks thin, unstable long-short tails and a hard-to-attribute result.
